unitTitle: Nutrition et mode de vie sain

criteria.feedback: Excellent - Each lesson has one specific, measurable learning goal that builds progressively
Perfect adherence - All lessons have exactly 3 practical decision points for teachers
Very good - Clear structure and materials lists, though some cooking activities may need slight prep
Strong - Instructions are clear and practical, with good balance of structure and flexibility

improvements: Consider adding quick prep notes for substitute teachers
Could include backup activities for equipment failures

criteria.feedback: Excellent progression from basic nutrition concepts to practical application
Good vocabulary development with consistent reinforcement, though could use more systematic spiraling
Strong developmental progression from awareness to application to celebration

strengths: Logical sequence from theory to practice
Clear connections between lessons stated explicitly
Core lessons (1-14) systematically cover all expectations
improvements: Could strengthen vocabulary spiraling with more explicit review

criteria.feedback: Good teacher support with decision points and differentiation guidance
Adequate flexibility, though some activities are quite structured
Excellent decision points that anticipate real classroom challenges

strengths: Realistic decision points address common classroom situations
Differentiation strategies are practical and achievable
Real-world connections are meaningful and age-appropriate
Home connections strengthen learning beyond classroom
improvements: Could add more 'what if' scenarios for challenging situations
Consider including more open-ended exploration time

curriculumAlignment.feedback: Excellent coverage of all four expectations with clear mapping

ageAppropriateness.feedback: Highly appropriate for Grade 1 students with excellent use of hands-on, sensory learning

culturalResponsiveness.feedback: Good inclusion of dietary alternatives and family diversity, could expand cultural food examples

safetyConsiderations.feedback: Strong attention to food safety, allergies, and age-appropriate cooking activities

pedagogicalStrengths: Excellent integration of hands-on learning with cooking and gardening
Strong use of movement and kinesthetic learning throughout
Progressive skill building from awareness to application
Meaningful real-world connections in every lesson
Inclusive approach to diverse dietary needs and family structures
Balance of individual and collaborative activities
Creative use of dramatic play (restaurant, detective, olympics)
Consistent integration of hygiene and self-care habits
innovativeElements: Detective investigation approach to analyzing meals
Restaurant dramatic play for menu planning
Integration of mindfulness in sleep/relaxation lessons
recommendations: Add more systematic vocabulary review in later lessons
Include backup activities for weather-dependent or equipment-dependent lessons
Consider adding family cooking challenge as extension
Expand cultural food examples in early lessons
Add quick assessment rubrics for key practical skills
Consider creating parent information sheet about nutrition goals

substituteFriendliness.feedback: Generally very accessible with clear instructions, though cooking lessons may need prep support

resourceRequirements.budget: Moderate - requires fresh foods and basic cooking supplies
resourceRequirements.preparation: Medium - some lessons require food prep and material organization
resourceRequirements.sustainability: High - many materials are reusable, gardening creates ongoing learning

differentiation.feedback: Excellent provision for various learning styles, abilities, and dietary restrictions

engagement.feedback: Highly engaging with variety of activities, hands-on learning, and student choice

finalRecommendation: APPROVED - This unit demonstrates exceptional pedagogical design with strong progression, authentic learning experiences, and practical application. The integration of nutrition education with cooking, movement, and hygiene creates a comprehensive health education experience perfectly suited for Grade 1 French Immersion students.
criticalSuccessFactors: Celebration and pride-building motivate continued healthy habits
